note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 52 homes for sale in France, each one checked by a person.
In France, the median asking price of those 52 homes is €69,900 (€1,175 per m², from the 48 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €39,000 and the most expensive €285,000.
Taxes and fees add about 7–8.5% to the price of a home in France (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer taxes (droits de mutation) of about 5.8%, or about 6.3% in departments that raised their rate for 2025 to March 2028; notary fee (émoluments) on a sliding scale from 3.87% down to 0.799% plus 20% VAT, about 1.3% on a €150,000 home; land security contribution (contribution de sécurité immobilière) 0.10%; disbursements (débours) of about €800 to €1,200; the agent fee is usually built into the advertised price (FAI) and paid by the seller, sometimes shared.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Foreigners can buy property in France without major restrictions, and non-EU buyers do not need a permit, although the paperwork can take longer.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners pay an annual property tax (taxe foncière) set by the local authorities, and owners of a furnished second home also pay housing tax (taxe d'habitation), which some communes raise by a surcharge of 5% to 60%.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay French income tax on French rental income at a minimum rate of 20% (30% above about €27,500), plus social charges of 17.2%, or 7.5% for people covered by social security in another EU/EEA country or Switzerland.

homes.title: 171 m² house with a former shop in the centre of Bussière-Poitevine
homes.title_es: Casa de 171 m² con antiguo local comercial en el centro de Bussière-Poitevine
homes.summary: In the heart of the village, next to the baker, pharmacy and school: a cellar, a kitchen, a living room, a WC and a former shop with a street window on the ground floor; two bedrooms and two shower rooms on the first floor; and a near-independent top floor with its own kitchen, living room, bedroom and shower room. Room for a family, a business with living space or a holiday let. On the Limoges–Poitiers road. Asking €39,950, about €234/m².

homes.title: Stone country house from 1550 with a mezzanine and 1,686 m² of land in Nieuil, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de piedra de 1550 con altillo y 1.686 m² de terreno en Nieuil, Charente
homes.summary: A stone country house dating from 1550 in a quiet hamlet, 5 km from shops. It was renovated between 2005 and 2010: the old part keeps a living room with a big fireplace and a bedroom, the renovated part has an open fitted kitchen, a shower room and a mezzanine under the roof. Semi-detached, on 1,686 m² of land with trees. Asking €109,760, about €946/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 19th-century longère on one level with garage in Lencloître, Vienne
homes.title_es: Longère del siglo XIX totalmente renovada en una planta con garaje en Lencloître, Vienne
homes.summary: A 19th-century longère, fully renovated and all on one level. East and west light fills a living room, lounge and dining room; the modern kitchen is separate. Two bedrooms, a laundry, a garage and a 620 m² garden with a terrace. Energy rating D. Asking €123,000, about €1,206/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a 60 m² living space and mezzanine near Villefagnan, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con 60 m² de zona de día y altillo cerca de Villefagnan, Charente
homes.summary: A well renovated stone house in a hamlet 2 km from Villefagnan and 7 km from Ruffec. The 60 m² living space has a 12 kW wood stove and an open fitted kitchen with a 12.5 m² pantry. A bedroom, a walk-in shower room and a WC are on the ground floor; a 19.5 m² mezzanine and two more bedrooms upstairs. 153 m² on a 1,334 m² plot. Energy rating D. Asking €125,000, about €817/m².

homes.title: Furnished old stone house with a 53 m² living room and 2,825 m² of garden in Bessac, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa antigua de piedra amueblada con salón de 53 m² y 2.825 m² de jardín en Bessac, Charente
homes.summary: A characterful old house sold fully furnished. The ground floor has a 53 m² living room under exposed beams with a wood stove and a fitted kitchen, opening to a terrace with open countryside views. Two bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs, a cellar, and 2,825 m² of enclosed garden with trees. Drainage is compliant. Windows are single-glazed timber and the energy rating is E. Asking €134,375, about €1,158/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with open countryside views and a heat pump near Saint-Vaury, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada con vistas abiertas al campo y bomba de calor cerca de Saint-Vaury, Creuse
homes.summary: A renovated stone house with a wide open view over the Creuse countryside. Dining room with fitted kitchen, a lounge and a shower room downstairs; a landing office, two bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs. Air-to-air heat pump on the ground floor, compliant drainage and energy rating C. 931 m² of land. Asking €136,250, about €1,390/m².

homes.title: Renovated old house with stone walls and terracotta floors in the Perche, 3 minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou
homes.title_es: Casa antigua renovada con muros de piedra y suelos de barro en el Perche, a 3 minutos de Nogent-le-Rotrou
homes.summary: A renovated old house in a hamlet of only three houses, with an open view, three minutes from Nogent-le-Rotrou. The living room keeps its terracotta tiles and stone walls, with a pellet stove and an open fitted kitchen. Three bedrooms and a shower room upstairs. A front courtyard and a small garden with trees on 386 m². Energy rating D. Asking €137,900, about €1,702/m².

homes.title: Former level-crossing keeper's house renovated in 2023 on 1,824 m² in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Antigua casa de guardabarrera renovada en 2023 con 1.824 m² en Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.summary: An old level-crossing keeper's house, 2.5 km from the centre of Bergerac, fully renovated in 2023. Downstairs a fully equipped kitchen opens to the dining room, with a bedroom, a shower room and a laundry on the same level. Upstairs a landing room for an office and a large bedroom. The fenced 1,824 m² plot has a well and a vaulted cellar. Energy rating D. Asking €139,000, about €1,805/m².

homes.title: Tastefully renovated stone-fronted house with full basement near the station in Salbris, Sologne
homes.title_es: Casa con fachada de piedra renovada con gusto y sótano completo junto a la estación en Salbris, Sologne
homes.summary: A fully renovated house in the centre of Salbris, close to shops and the train station. Fitted kitchen, a bright living room and a bedroom with its own shower on the ground floor; two more bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs. Reversible air conditioning, PVC windows with electric shutters, a full basement and a terrace on a fenced 665 m² plot. Energy rating D. Asking €146,990, about €1,771/m².

homes.title: Brick house with a 2019 living-room extension, garden and garage in Ohain, Avesnois
homes.title_es: Casa de ladrillo con ampliación del salón de 2019, jardín y garaje en Ohain, Avesnois
homes.summary: A semi-detached brick house in the green Avesnois, next to the Belgian border. The living space with dining area, kitchen and lounge sits in an extension built in 2019, with a shower room on the same floor. Three bedrooms upstairs. PVC double glazing throughout, mains drainage and a redone electrical panel. Terrace, garden, a large garage and parking on 490 m². Energy rating D. Asking €148,400, about €1,400/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 250 m² house from 1900 with five bedrooms in La Courtine, Creuse
homes.title_es: Casa de 1900 totalmente renovada de 250 m² con cinco dormitorios en La Courtine, Creuse
homes.summary: A traditional house from 1900, fully renovated, in a village with all services. A large bright living room, an open fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room make a complete ground floor. Four bedrooms and a second shower room upstairs, and one more room on the top floor. Built over a cellar with a boiler room and workshop, with a tended garden of 876 m². Energy rating D. Asking €149,000, about €596/m².

homes.title: Renovated three-level house with an energy rating C in Decazeville, Aveyron
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de tres plantas con certificado C en Decazeville, Aveyron
homes.summary: A neat, renovated townhouse: a cellar, a laundry and an entrance on the ground floor; a bright living room with an open kitchen, a bedroom and a WC on the first floor; more bedrooms, a modern shower room, a separate WC and a study on the second. Laminate floors, white walls and energy rating C, so low running costs. Figeac and the Lot valley are close. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,980, about €431/m².

homes.title: Four-room 71 m² flat with two balconies in Mulhouse
homes.title_es: Piso de cuatro estancias y 71 m² con dos balcones en Mulhouse
homes.summary: 71 m² on the 4th floor: a spacious living room with a balcony, a fitted kitchen with a second balcony, three bright bedrooms, a bathroom with a bath, a separate WC and a cellar. Built-in wardrobes in the hall. Energy rating F, no lift. Asking €51,800, about €730/m².

homes.title: Country house with a veranda near the Saint-Rémy lake, Thiers
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con veranda junto al lago de Saint-Rémy, Thiers
homes.summary: In a quiet hamlet 5 km from Thiers and the Saint-Rémy-sur-Durolle lake: a bright veranda, an open kitchen onto a living room with a fireplace insert; two bedrooms, a study, a bathroom and a WC on the first floor; a spacious third bedroom and an attic on the second. Electric heating; energy rating G (about €2,400–3,300 a year). Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €49,900, about €416/m².

homes.title: 137 m² village house with a roof terrace near Carcassonne
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 137 m² con terraza en la azotea cerca de Carcasona
homes.summary: A dual-aspect house with 137 m² in Azille, a Minervois wine village near Carcassonne: four bedrooms, a living room with a working fireplace, a large kitchen, a games room, an office, a garage and a private roof terrace that is not overlooked.

homes.title: 3-bed stone house in the heart of a village
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 3 dormitorios en pleno centro del pueblo
homes.summary: Stone house in the center of a village : Le Lonzac, Nouvelle-Aquitaine Right in the heart of village life, this stone village house offers a lovely balance of indoor space and outdoor corners to enjoy.

homes.title: Fully renovated four-bedroom house with balcony and garden in Bergerac, Dordogne
homes.title_es: Casa de cuatro dormitorios completamente renovada con balcón y jardín en Bergerac, Dordoña
homes.summary: A 150 m² stone house in Bergerac, on the Dordogne river, on a plot of about 270 m² and close to shops and services. The advert describes a total renovation with an energy rating of C and ducted reversible heating and cooling. Five rooms including four bedrooms, two bathrooms and three WCs, plus a balcony, a garden and two parking spaces. It is one of two lots in a small co-ownership with no running charges, as stated in the advert. Asking €139,000, about €927/m², which is low for a renovated house of this size in the Dordogne.

homes.title: 66 m² flat with open views and a lift in Dijon
homes.title_es: Piso de 66 m² con vistas abiertas y ascensor en Dijon
homes.summary: 66 m² on the 4th floor of a residence with a lift: a large bright living room, a fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, in good condition, with clear views. Close to trams, schools and shops; energy rating C. Asking €57,000, about €864/m².

homes.title: Bright south-west three-room flat with a lift in Le Havre
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones al suroeste con ascensor en Le Havre
homes.summary: 70 m² on the 5th floor with a lift in quiet Caucriauville: an 18 m² living room full of light, a separate 10 m² kitchen, two bedrooms with wardrobes and a bathroom. Freshly redone and empty; energy rating C. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €59,990, about €857/m².

homes.title: Top-floor loft with an 82 m² cathedral living room in Lodève
homes.title_es: Loft en la última planta con sala de catedrales de 82 m² en Lodève
homes.summary: A fully renovated 215 m² loft on the top floor of a historic building, below the Larzac plateau. The cathedral living room is over 82 m² with exposed timber beams, light from both sides and a pellet stove. Five bedrooms including a master suite, a 12 m² kitchen and a 31 m² terrace with panoramic views over the Lergue. Energy class B. Asking €285,000, about €1,326/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-room flat for €39,000 in Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso de dos habitaciones reformado por 39.000 € en Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 45 m² on the ground floor of a small building (7 lots) on rue Dufour, Carnot: a through living room, a new fitted kitchen, a bedroom with its own shower room and a separate WC. Double glazing and low charges (€703 a year). Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €39,000, about €867/m².

homes.title: Charming furnished two-room flat near the universities, Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso encantador amueblado de dos habitaciones junto a las universidades, Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 45 m² on the 2nd floor of a small secure building on rue Pierre Sémard: a 17 m² living room with a fireplace, a semi-open kitchen, a 10 m² bedroom, a bathroom and a cellar. Nicely furnished; energy rating G, so it cannot be newly let without insulation work. Asking €48,000, about €1,067/m².

homes.title: Hilltop village house with a sunny terrace in Bourmont
homes.title_es: Casa en lo alto de un pueblo histórico, con terraza soleada, en Bourmont
homes.summary: On the heights of the historic village of Bourmont, in Haute-Marne: a fitted kitchen, a large living room with a fireplace, a balcony and a big fenced south-east terrace, two large bedrooms, an office and a dressing room, plus a garage.

homes.title: Three-room flat with a balcony, cellar and parking in Mulhouse
homes.title_es: Piso de tres habitaciones con balcón, trastero y aparcamiento en Mulhouse
homes.summary: 60 m² on the 3rd floor of a 1963 building on Rue des Pins: a living room, a kitchen, two bedrooms (11 and 13 m²), a bathroom, a separate WC, a balcony, a cellar and parking. Parquet floors, collective gas heating; energy rating D. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €60,000, about €1,000/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 1700s stone village house of 180 m² near La Rochefoucauld, Charente
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra de los años 1700 lista para entrar de 180 m² cerca de La Rochefoucauld, Charente
homes.summary: About 180 m² of old stone house for €189,000, roughly €1,050 per m², and the advert says it is ready to move into. The ground floor has three rooms of over 30 m² each: a living room, a large beamed kitchen and a bedroom with its own bathroom, so you can live on one level. Upstairs are a 34 m² bedroom with a private bathroom, a 23 m² office, a mezzanine and a terrace. Exposed stone, old beams and stoves. Small easy garden, carport and workshop. The village is 5 km from La Rochefoucauld and 30 km from Angoulême TGV station. Energy rating D.

homes.title: Character house with panoramic views in Treignac
homes.title_es: Casa con carácter y vistas panorámicas en Treignac
homes.summary: A character house of about 88 m² in Treignac, one of the 'most beautiful villages' of the Corrèze, close enough to walk to the shops, with panoramic views over the valley. A 25 m² living room with fireplace and wood stove, two bedrooms under the beams and a modern shower room. No garden to look after.

homes.title: Stone town house with three bedrooms and a modern shower
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en el centro del pueblo con tres dormitorios y ducha moderna
homes.summary: A stone house in the heart of Auzances, in the green Creuse countryside: a bright living room with a fitted kitchen, three bedrooms, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower and a basement with a laundry.

homes.title: 50 m² flat with city views on the tram line in Le Mans
homes.title_es: Piso de 50 m² con vistas a la ciudad junto al tranvía en Le Mans
homes.summary: 50.7 m² on the 5th floor in Maillets-Bellevue: a living room, a modern kitchen, a bedroom and a new shower room, with long views over the rooftops. The T2 tram stops at the door and the station is three minutes by car. Asking €55,000, about €1,086/m².

homes.title: Move-in-ready village house by the famous canal locks
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo lista para entrar junto a las famosas esclusas del canal
homes.summary: A comfortable 52 m² village house in Rogny-les-Sept-Écluses, known for its seven historic canal locks: a living room with an insert fireplace, a fitted and equipped kitchen, a bathroom and two attic bedrooms, plus a garden with a wooden shed. No major work needed.

homes.title: Furnished studio with a balcony near the Palais des Congrès, Perpignan
homes.title_es: Estudio amueblado con balcón junto al Palacio de Congresos, Perpiñán
homes.summary: 35 m² on the 4th floor with a lift in a secure residence with a garden: a bright living room with a balcony, a semi-open fitted kitchen, a shower room and a cellar. Sold furnished; charges about €115 a month including heating and water. Asking €57,000, about €1,631/m².

homes.title: Recently renovated through flat with a heat pump in Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso pasante recién reformado con bomba de calor en Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 52 m² in a handsome building on boulevard Valbenoite, near the university: a big living room over the courtyard, a fitted kitchen, a bedroom, a shower room and a WC. Recently renovated, heat-pump heating and double glazing; a garage can be added. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €60,000, about €1,154/m².

homes.title: Town house with a mezzanine in historic Saint-Mathieu, Perpignan
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con altillo en el barrio histórico de Saint-Mathieu, Perpiñán
homes.summary: A 50 m² town house at the edge of the historic Saint-Mathieu quarter, with a light well: a living room with an open kitchen, a master bedroom with its own bathroom and WC, and a mezzanine upstairs. Freshly finished, ready to live in. Asking €60,000, about €1,200/m².

homes.title: Renovated townhouse with new kitchen and air conditioning in Masseube, Gers
homes.title_es: Casa adosada renovada con cocina nueva y aire acondicionado en Masseube, Gers
homes.summary: A renovated 70 m² townhouse in Masseube for €69,500, under €1,000 per m², close to the shops and services. Downstairs a 25 m² living room opens to a fully fitted kitchen, with a storage room and WC. Upstairs are two bedrooms of 13 and 16 m², each with its own shower and basin. The roof was redone in 2013, the attic is insulated and there is reversible air conditioning. Connected to mains drainage. Energy rating C, good for an older house. The photos show fresh floors, a new kitchen and clean shower units. No garden is mentioned.

homes.title: Renovated town house with a central patio in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa urbana renovada con patio central en el centro de La Charité-sur-Loire, Borgoña
homes.summary: A renovated town house in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, the old priory town on the Loire, with shops, schools and transport close by. 156 m² with six rooms, four of them bedrooms, arranged around a central patio, plus a redone 27 m² studio-type space with a new roof and a large cellar. Electrics redone, full insulation carried out in 2011, double glazing, mains gas heating, mains drainage and fibre available. Asking €119,500, about €766/m². Property tax €970 a year; the advert gives gas at about €1,200 and electricity about €1,000 a year.

homes.title: Studio with a view over the port of Marseille, gated residence
homes.title_es: Estudio con vistas al puerto de Marsella, residencia cerrada
homes.summary: 28 m² on the 3rd floor with a lift, in a gated residence with a caretaker: a bright room with an open green kitchen, a shower room and a wide view over the port. Collective gas heating and hot water, free parking inside the residence. Asking €54,000, about €1,929/m².

homes.title: Modern two-room flat with an open kitchen near the universities, Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Piso moderno de dos habitaciones con cocina abierta junto a las universidades, Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: 40 m² on the 2nd floor of a small building on rue de Tardy: an open kitchen with a breakfast bar onto the living room, a bedroom with its own shower room and a separate WC. PVC double glazing, low charges, good condition. Asking €54,000, about €1,350/m².

homes.title: Renovated one-bedroom flat in central Roubaix, near Lille
homes.title_es: Piso reformado de un dormitorio en el centro de Roubaix, junto a Lille
homes.summary: 43 m² on the 3rd floor near Roubaix centre: a bright living room with a new grey kitchen, an 11.8 m² bedroom and a modern bathroom, new floors throughout. Lille is 15 minutes by metro. Energy rating F (electric heating). Asking €57,000, about €1,326/m².

homes.title: Cosy stone house with pellet stove and views near Limoux
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra acogedora con estufa de pellets y vistas cerca de Limoux
homes.summary: A stone village house of 73.8 m² ten minutes from Limoux: a 20 m² kitchen and living room, a lounge with a pellet stove, a bedroom with shower room, and an attic bedroom of 18 m². Fibre internet and very nice views from the bedrooms. Ready to live in.

homes.title: Corbières village house with a modern kitchen
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo en las Corbières con cocina moderna
homes.summary: A three-storey village house of 58 m² in Durban-Corbières, in the wine hills behind Narbonne: living room with a modern open kitchen, two bedrooms, an office and two cellars. The Mediterranean beaches are about 30 minutes away.

homes.title: 19th-century stone village house with wisteria courtyard and terrace in Frayssinet, Lot
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra del siglo XIX con patio de glicina y terraza en Frayssinet, Lot
homes.summary: A 19th-century stone house on a quiet lane in a peaceful village in the Lot, in Occitanie. About 113 m² with a generous sitting room, a kitchen diner with modern appliances, three bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor, and two shower rooms. The agent describes it as comfortable and habitable as it stands. Behind stone walls there is a private courtyard shaded by mature wisteria and a raised terrace. Glazing and heating could be upgraded over time, as the advert says. Shops are about 10 minutes away and a larger town with a railway station 20 minutes. Asking €125,000 including fees, about €1,106/m².

homes.title: Furnished loft-style studio with a new bathroom in the hyper-centre, Saint-Étienne
homes.title_es: Estudio tipo loft amueblado con baño nuevo en pleno centro, Saint-Étienne
homes.summary: On the 5th floor with a lift of a bourgeois building at 16 rue de la Résistance, three minutes from place Jean-Jaurès: a 26.5 m² living room with kitchen under wooden beams, a sleeping mezzanine and a bathroom redone in July 2026, plus a vaulted cellar. Sold furnished. Asking €55,500, about €1,576/m².

homes.title: 2-bed country cottage in a lovely hamlet
homes.title_es: Casita de campo de 2 dormitorios en una aldea preciosa
homes.summary: Country cottage in an adorable hamlet : Exideuil-sur-Vienne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine A bright kitchen, rustic warmth, and plenty of outdoor space give this two-bedroom country cottage a wonderfully relaxed character.

homes.title: 114 m² town house with a courtyard near Limoux
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 114 m² con patio cerca de Limoux
homes.summary: In Espéraza, a lively village with shops 15 minutes from Limoux, in the upper Aude valley: 114 m² with a 31 m² open kitchen-living room, a utility room, a private interior courtyard, two large bedrooms and two more rooms to use as you like.

homes.title: Renovated stone house on the Canal du Nivernais in Champvert, Burgundy
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra renovada en el Canal du Nivernais en Champvert, Borgoña
homes.summary: A stone village house with direct access to the towpath of the Canal du Nivernais, renovated over the years and sold as needing no work. About 160 m2 for 188,000 euros, so under 1,200 euros per m2. There is a 50 m2 living room with a pellet stove, a fitted kitchen with an island, two large bedrooms (one en suite) and a 30 m2 study in the former stables. The roof was redone in 2024, gas central heating dates from 2017 and the energy rating is C. Garden of 1,225 m2, 5 minutes from Decize. Property tax 890 euros a year.

homes.title: Renovated studio with a balcony by the Bagatelle metro, Toulouse
homes.title_es: Estudio reformado con balcón junto al metro Bagatelle, Toulouse
homes.summary: 30 m² on the 4th floor with a lift, fully renovated with taste: a bright 17 m² living room opening onto a balcony with open views, a new fitted kitchen, a shower room and a sleeping area. Right by the Hippodrome shopping centre and two minutes from Bagatelle metro. Seller pays the agency fee. Asking €59,500, about €1,955/m².

homes.title: Renovated village house with energy rating B in the centre of Riez, Verdon
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada con calificación energética B en el centro de Riez, Verdon
homes.summary: A 91 m2 village house on a small square in the centre of Riez, fully renovated to current standards and rated B for energy, which is rare for an old Provençal house. It has two kitchens and living areas over the lower floors, two bedrooms (one with its own shower), a bathroom, reversible air conditioning in three zones and about 50 m2 of cellars. A small courtyard behind a wrought iron gate fits a table. Shops, schools, a hospital and two weekly markets are in the village, and Lake Sainte-Croix and the Verdon gorges are minutes away. About 1,750 euros per m2.

homes.title: Breton stone house with a conservatory near the Térénez beaches in Plouezoc'h
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra bretona con invernadero cerca de las playas de Térénez en Plouezoc'h
homes.summary: A granite and slate Breton house 5 minutes from the Térénez beaches and sailing school. It has 88 m² plus a 20 m² glazed conservatory along the garden side. Downstairs are a kitchen with dining space, a living and dining room, a bedroom and a bathroom, so single-level living is possible. Upstairs are two more bedrooms and an open area for an office. The plot is about 520 m² with parking. The kitchen is modern, but the upstairs rooms keep old wallpaper and the bathroom is dated, so plan to redecorate. Energy rating E.

homes.title: Renovated Luberon village house with vaulted cellar in Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo del Luberon renovada con bodega abovedada en Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
homes.summary: A fully renovated village house of about 90 m2 in the Luberon hills, priced near the low end of the portal's local sales range per m2. The fitted kitchen opens onto a vaulted stone cellar and a small terrace, the bright living room has a wood stove and open views, and there are two bedrooms, a modern shower room, two toilets and a utility room. The photos show beamed ceilings and new finishes throughout. Shops and the village swimming pool are about 400 metres away. Asking 210,000 euros.

homes.title: One-bedroom flat four minutes' walk from Grenoble station
homes.title_es: Piso de un dormitorio a cuatro minutos a pie de la estación de Grenoble
homes.summary: 33 m² on the ground floor in the Chorier-Berriat area: a living room with a kitchen, a separate 9.6 m² bedroom and a shower room, freshly painted with new floors. Grenoble station is a four-minute walk and six bus lines stop five minutes away. Energy rating F (electric heating). Asking €59,000, about €1,777/m².

homes.title: Stone house with a private riverbank and outbuildings in Vendeuvre, Normandy
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con orilla privada de río y construcciones anexas en Vendeuvre, Normandía
homes.summary: A 99.5 m2 stone house on an enclosed 1,545 m2 plot that runs down to a river with private banks. Downstairs are a living room with a wood-burning insert, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom, and upstairs three bedrooms of 13 to 15 m2. Double glazing, a recent air-to-water heat pump and solar panels are already in place, and the outbuildings add about 150 m2 with two garages, a workshop and a carport. The advert says some finishing and refreshing work is still to plan. Saint-Pierre-sur-Dives is a 7-minute drive. Property tax 647 euros a year.

homes.title: 2009 duplex house with a private garden in a spa village
homes.title_es: Casa dúplex de 2009 con jardín privado en un pueblo termal
homes.summary: A semi-detached duplex house built in 2009 in Encausse-les-Thermes, a spa village at the foot of the Pyrenees: living room opening onto a 200 m² private garden, open kitchen, two bedrooms upstairs, terrace and utility room.

homes.title: Cosy, fully kept village house below the Montagne Noire
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo acogedora y bien cuidada al pie de la Montagne Noire
homes.summary: A charming village house of about 50 m² in Saint-Denis, Aude, at the foot of the Montagne Noire north of Carcassonne. Fully maintained: open kitchen and living room, a modern walk-in shower room and two bedrooms under the beams.
